settings.title: Settings
settings.description: app_settings keys. Every change requires a justification and is audited.
settings.killSwitchWarning: Kill switch: affects every user immediately.

keys.commerce_enabled_desc: Turning it off blocks cart and test orders for everyone.
keys.ai_enabled_desc: Turning it off makes the engine fall back to deterministic.
keys.ai_provider_desc: openai and gemini require a server key; without one, deterministic is used.
keys.experiment_open_desc: Turning it off closes public sign-up in the database itself. Still allowed: e-mails with a pending invitation, e-mails on the bootstrap list and demo accounts created on this page.
keys.avatars_uploads_enabled_desc: Turning it off pauses new profile photo uploads by users and heroes. Photos already uploaded stay online and can be removed.
keys.retention_days_desc: Approved policy; changing it requires reviewing the privacy documentation.
keys.bootstrap_admin_emails_desc: Accounts that get the admin role on first login. Use with care.
keys.bootstrap_warning: Any e-mail in this list becomes admin on sign-up. Double-check before saving.
keys.missing: Key missing in the database (it will be created on save).

ops.description: System routines run on demand. Results are audited.

retention.description: Scopes preserved from anonymization for legal evidence or incidents. Review is mandatory.
